about: Line ceilings for the repository's largest hand-written code files, read by scripts/check-line-ceilings.mjs in the fast check. A listed file may shrink but not grow past its ceiling; a pull request that shrinks one lowers its ceiling (--write). A code file not listed here may not pass the threshold. New systems go in their own modules (the factory pattern of v2/card-game/sleep-view.mjs and speech-text.mjs, the seams of the Rust crate), where the fast check can choose the tests that cover them (scripts/fast-smokes.json). Raise a ceiling only as a reviewed exception, in the same diff, with the reason in the pull request. v2/orchestrator-rust/src/main.rs keeps its own ceiling and history (v2/scripts/main-rs-line-ceiling.txt). Generated files, lockfiles and assets follow scripts/change-budget.json and are never counted.
